title: Password reset requested
purpose: Check your email for recovery instructions.
summary: Follow the recovery instructions for your laboratory. A reset request keeps your existing password until you use the emailed link.

tasks.title: Reset the password
steps: If email recovery is available, open the email and follow the reset link. Check your spam folder if it has not arrived.

tasks.title: Go back to sign in
steps: Select the OpenBGA Lab Ops name at the top.

good_to_know: This page does not confirm that an account exists.
When outgoing email is off, ask the laboratory administrator to reset your password.

sections.title: State and next action
paragraphs: With email delivery enabled, this page acknowledges a submitted request without identifying account holders. Check the mailbox and spam folder, or contact the laboratory. Use the brand to return to the application.
With outgoing email disabled, the page explains how to reach the administrator for a reset. Back to sign in returns to the login form.
